definitions: The act of exerting force to draw something towards oneself or in a particular direction.
The act of attracting or drawing someone's attention or interest.
The act of removing something by force or effort.
The act of achieving or performing something successfully.
examples: The pulling of the rope was a team effort.
There was a strong pulling towards the new exhibit.
The pulling of the weeds took all morning.
The pulling off of the stunt was impressive.
